title: Yuckenfutz Tradez — Daily Plan — Wed Nov 18, 2026 (VIX expiration · Fed minutes)

bias.reason: Wednesday opens just above the 7373 pivot after a two-day selloff. Monday was a trend day down (SPY −1.9%). Tuesday flushed ES to 7308–09, under the Nov 5 low at 7323, then recovered. ES closed 7363.50 (SPX 7340.54, SPY 732.44, right on the 200-day average). After the close Nvidia beat and raised; ES ran to 7434.75 before fading to 7376 at 8:02 PM PT, a few points above 7373. The structure is still bearish: negative gamma on every expiry through December, and no bounce counts as a structural reclaim until 7421, then 7455. A hold of 7373 opens 7390, then 7414 (weekly VWAP), then 7421. Failure of 7373 opens 7348, then 7316; acceptance below 7308–09 opens 7275, which sits below the plan band. The unpadded plan band is 7308–7437 (Tuesday regular session union the post-close range), padded by 0.25 × today's implied move (SPX ±1.06%, about 77 points) to about 7289–7456. ES ≈ SPX + 22.97 from Tuesday's official closes. Wednesday is VIX expiration (morning settlement); Fed minutes are at 11:00 AM PT.
